messages:
Sam - AE: @Carlos quick sync — we need a Dedicated GPU pool for the ZenHealth POC. Primary region ap-southeast-1, fallback eu-west-1. POC window ~4 weeks. Target peak concurrency 15-25 concurrent requests, avg payload ~350 tokens. Can you confirm SKU recommendation, rough cost, and provisioning lead time?
Priya (SE): For that profile I'd start with 2 x h100-80gb nodes as a baseline for latency-sensitive work. If cost is the driver, 3 x a100-40gb is a reasonable cheaper baseline but will trade throughput. H100 gives better headroom for longer sequences.
Marta (InfraOps): To provision Dedicated pools we need: customer CIDR for VPC peering (/24 recommended), allowed firewall egress rules, and whether they want private control plane. Lead time 2-3 business days after we have PO + network info for baseline.
Carlos (ZenHealth): Thanks. A couple Qs: 1) Is Hosted API fallback allowed? 2) We handle PHI — what's the recommendation? 3) Ballpark monthly committed cost for 2x h100 vs 3x a100?
Priya (SE): Hosted fallback can be set up for non-PHI testing only. For PHI we recommend Dedicated with VPC + KMS, or Private deployment if they require full on-prem isolation. I'll follow up with precise cost numbers but can give ballpark after this thread.
Leo (SRE): Sizing note — if you want ~2x headroom for spikes, plan 3 h100 nodes and enable autoscaling (min=2, max=6) with burst credits. We need a sample trace (sequence length distribution and request inter-arrival) to tune batching and actual node count.
Sam - AE: Carlos — can you share an anonymized traces sample and confirm POC start date? Also confirm if ZenHealth legal can sign a short PO for reserved capacity.
Carlos (ZenHealth): I'll send anonymized traces + CIDR by EOD. POC target start next Monday but could shift by a week if provisioning takes longer. Legal is ok with a short PO for POC trial under our procurement timeline.
Marta (InfraOps): Also note: for Dedicated + VPC we can enable customer KMS and audit logs. If they need Private (no public egress), that route adds ~3-4 weeks for setup and an enterprise contract.
deploy-bot: pool-provision-request created — ticket #DP-3482 assigned to Marta.
Priya (SE): Action items: 1) Carlos to share traces + CIDR 2) Sam to confirm POC dates and PO cadence 3) Marta to prep VPC/KMS checklist and draft provisioning spec 4) Leo to estimate autoscale thresholds after trace.
Carlos (ZenHealth): Sounds good — sending files now. One last thing: can we get a test API key for hosted just to smoke test integration (non-PHI traffic)?
Priya (SE): Yes — we can issue a hosted test key for non-PHI testing within 24h. We'll label it TEST-ZENHEALTH and set rate limits.
Sam - AE: Thanks team. Priya/Marta/Leo — I'll schedule a quick 30m call tomorrow to finalize sizing and signoff. :thumbsup:
